description: DG(app) membrane-insertion benchmark: AADAC family against 45 experimental cleaved signal peptides and 45 type II signal anchors
code:
import requests, re, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Referer":"https://dgpred.cbr.su.se/index.php?p=fullscan"})
def st_(q,f="accession,ft_signal,ft_transmem,sequence"):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query={q}&fields={f}&format=json",timeout=300).json()["results"]
sp_set=st_("(organism_id:9606)+AND+(reviewed:true)+AND+(ft_signal:*)")
sa_set=st_('(organism_id:9606)+AND+(reviewed:true)+AND+(ft_transmem:"Signal-anchor+for+type+II+membrane+protein")')

# reference panels, matched architecture: SP end <=30 ; signal-anchor TM start <=15
SP=[]; SA=[]
for e in sp_set:
    sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
    for f in e.get("features",[]):
        if f["type"]=="Signal" and f["location"]["end"].get("value") and \
           "ECO:0000269" in {ev.get("evidenceCode") for ev in f.get("evidences",[])} and f["location"]["end"]["value"]<=30 and len(sq)>60:
            SP.append((e["primaryAccession"],sq)); break
for e in sa_set:
    sq=e["sequence"]["value"]
    tms=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane" and "Signal-anchor" in f.get("description","")]
    if tms and tms[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]<=15 and len(sq)>60: SA.append((e["primaryAccession"],sq))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
SPs=[SP[i] for i in rng.choice(len(SP),45,replace=False)]
SAs=[SA[i] for i in rng.choice(len(SA),45,replace=False)]
print("panels: %d cleaved SP (experimental, end<=30), %d type II signal anchors (TM start<=15)"%(len(SPs),len(SAs)))

def dg(name,sq,win=55):
    for _ in range(2):
        try:
            r=s.post("https://dgpred.cbr.su.se/results.php?program=fullscan",
                     data={"seq":f">{name}\n{sq[:win]}\n","Lmin":"19","Lmax":"23","with_length":"on"},timeout=90)
            t=re.sub(r"<[^>]+>"," ",r.text).replace(" "," ")
            h=re.findall(r"(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(-?\d+\.\d+)\s+([A-Z]{15,30})",t)
            return min(float(x[3]) for x in h) if h else np.nan
        except Exception: time.sleep(1)
    return np.nan

vals={}
for lab,panel in [("SP_exp",SPs),("SA_typeII",SAs)]:
    out=[]
    for a,sq in panel:
        out.append(dg(a,sq)); time.sleep(0.25)
    vals[lab]=np.array(out,dtype=float)
    print(lab,"n=%d, missing(no helix)=%d"%(len(out),int(np.isnan(out).sum())))

accs={"AADACL2":"Q6P093","AADAC":"P22760","NCEH1":"Q6PIU2","AADACL3":"Q5VUY0","AADACL4":"Q5VUY2"}
qd={}
for k,a in accs.items():
    sq=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
    qd[k]=dg(k,sq); time.sleep(0.3)

A=vals["SP_exp"]; B=vals["SA_typeII"]
# treat "no helix predicted" as dG > 0 (non-inserting): assign +2.5 for ranking
A2=np.where(np.isnan(A),2.5,A); B2=np.where(np.isnan(B),2.5,B)
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(A2,B2)
auc=u.statistic/(len(A2)*len(B2))
print("\nDG(app) kcal/mol  (negative = inserts)")
print(f"  cleaved SP (experimental) n={len(A2)}: median {np.median(A2):+.2f}  IQR [{np.percentile(A2,25):+.2f},{np.percentile(A2,75):+.2f}]  %inserting(dG<0): {100*np.mean(A2<0):.0f}%")
print(f"  type II signal anchor      n={len(B2)}: median {np.median(B2):+.2f}  IQR [{np.percentile(B2,25):+.2f},{np.percentile(B2,75):+.2f}]  %inserting(dG<0): {100*np.mean(B2<0):.0f}%")
print(f"  Mann-Whitney U p={u.pvalue:.3g}; AUC(SP>SA) = {auc:.3f}")
print("\n  query     dG_app   percentile among SP_exp   percentile among SA_typeII")
for k,v in qd.items():
    print(f"  {k:9s} {v:+7.3f}   {100*np.mean(A2<v):21.1f}%   {100*np.mean(B2<v):24.1f}%")
pd.DataFrame(dict(panel=["SP_exp"]*len(A2)+["SA_typeII"]*len(B2),dG=np.r_[A2,B2])).to_csv("dGapp_reference_panels.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,5))
bins=np.linspace(-4,3,30)
ax.hist(A2,bins=bins,alpha=.55,color="#3a7ca5",label=f"cleaved signal peptide, experimental (n={len(A2)})",density=True)
ax.hist(B2,bins=bins,alpha=.55,color="#d1495b",label=f"type II signal anchor, TM start<=15 (n={len(B2)})",density=True)
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=1)
cols={"AADACL2":"black","AADAC":"#8d6a9f","NCEH1":"#2e8b57","AADACL3":"#c08552","AADACL4":"#999"}
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(qd.items()):
    ax.axvline(v,color=cols[k],ls="--",lw=2)
    ax.text(v,ax.get_ylim()[1]*(0.96-0.10*i)," "+k,color=cols[k],fontsize=9,weight="bold")
ax.set_xlabel("predicted $\\Delta G_{app}$ of Sec61 insertion (kcal/mol), Hessa biological hydrophobicity scale")
ax.set_ylabel("density"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
ax.set_title("AADACL2's N-terminal helix is thermodynamically competent to insert,\nlike type II signal anchors and unlike cleaved signal peptides",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
